pages.text: Press $(k:key.bromax_battle.guard) to raise your weapon into a $(l)guard$(), and again to lower it. Brackets around the crosshair show it's up.$(br2)A guard stops one hit from the front completely, like a shield. Then it drops, and the brackets turn $(4)red$() while it recovers for a moment before it can be raised again.

Hits from behind or the sides get through, and attacking with either hand lowers the guard.$(br2)A blocked blow still pushes your $(l:bromax_battle:overpower/the_bar)pressure bar$(), by half as much as a hit would. Guarding buys time; it doesn't win a fight on its own.
